answer_1.quote: We have established a scenario to evaluate the performance of the FedCoT framework across a range of text generation tasks... we conduct an evaluation of FedCoT on 4 QA datasets. Specifically, we include CommonsenseQA (CQA), OpenBookQA (OBQA), BoolQ, ArcE. For these datasets, we primarily use Accuracy as the evaluation metric.
